questions.stem: What is Data Matching and Linking about?
options: Encrypting records before they are shared
Matching and linking datasets across systems to find out which is the best record to link with
Reducing the number of rows returned by a query
Converting semi-structured formats into one format
questions.explanation: Data Matching and Linking matches and links datasets across systems to identify the best possible record, for example when the same kind of data arrives from several sources.

questions.stem: Which Master Data Management outcome is given as a use case for Data Matching and Linking?
questions.explanation: Generating the Golden Record for MDM is one of the use cases of Data Matching and Linking.

questions.stem: Is Data Matching and Linking a manual process?
options: Yes, it is done by data analysts reviewing records
Yes, but only for small datasets
No, it uses complex software with complex algorithms to find the right data
No, it is done by the customers themselves
questions.explanation: Matching and linking is not manual; it relies on complex software using complex algorithms to find the right data.

questions.stem: In the customer onboarding example, why is Data Matching and Linking needed?
options: Because the same customer may register two or three times via Online, Customer Service Centre or Branch channels
Because branches are in different cities
Because customer data must be encrypted
Because the CRM system cannot store addresses
questions.explanation: When a customer registers through several channels, matching and linking identifies the customer record with the highest weightage.

questions.stem: Which type of Data Matching and Linking matches exact fields such as National ID, Social Security Number or passport number?
questions.explanation: Referential matching links records on exact identifier fields such as National ID, Social Security Number or passport number.

questions.stem: Which type of Data Matching and Linking uses multiple fields such as name, date of birth and parents' names?
questions.explanation: Probabilistic matching combines several fields such as name, date of birth and parents' names to decide whether records match.

questions.stem: What is ML Association in Data Matching and Linking?
options: Matching on an exact national identifier
Machine learning searching for matching data elements to link
questions.explanation: ML Association is where machine learning searches for matching data elements to link.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a benefit of Data Matching and Linking?
options: Generate Golden Records for downstream systems
questions.explanation: Golden records, accuracy, segmentation and scam stoppage are listed benefits; reducing cloud compute costs is not.

questions.stem: Which benefit of Data Matching and Linking relates to regulatory obligations?
questions.explanation: Guaranteeing healthier compliance is among the listed benefits of Data Matching and Linking.

questions.stem: What are the three types of Data Matching and Linking?
questions.explanation: The three types are Referential, Probabilistic and ML Association.
